newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norsk Hydro oil platform contract goes to Saipem.
newsitem.headline: Norsk Hydro oil platform contract goes to Saipem.

text.p: Norsk Hydro ASA said on Wednesday it had awarded Saipem UK Ltd a contract for the transport and installation of the jacket and topsides for the Oseberg South oil platform.
The contract is worth around 280 million crowns ($38.1 million), Hydro said in a statement.
Oseberg South lies 13 km from the Oseberg Field centre in the North Sea. It is to be developed as a satellite platform, using existing infrastructure in the Oseberg area.

Recoverable reserves are estimated at 335 million barrels of oil. Part-processing of the oil will take place at Oseberg South, before it is piped to the field centre for further processing and transport to the terminal at Sture on the west coast of Norway.

Licence holders in the Oseberg unit are Norsk Hydro as operator with 13.68 percent, Den norske stats oljeselskap AS with 64.78 percent, Saga Petroleum ASA , Elf Petroleum with 5.77 percent, Mobil with 4.33 percent and Total with 2.88 percent.
